claims: The official OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP exporter sends an ordinary root and GenAI child into the real Chorus receiver
The public HttpSidecarWriter sends trace-linked retained content and explicit user feedback through generic sidecar endpoints
Chorus displays root latency, GenAI token usage, known cost, pricing coverage, feedback, service, and model identity
Default root-row promotion selects the GenAI child and persists an evaluation case retaining the observed content and exact OTLP trace, root, and span identifiers
The canonical OTLP export remains a standard ExportTraceServiceRequest containing both original spans
demoCommands: Official OpenTelemetry SDK plus OTLPSpanExporter to http://127.0.0.1:8116/v1/traces, HttpSidecarWriter to http://127.0.0.1:8116, then browser Promote
GET /api/summary, /api/evals, and /api/otlp/traces to verify metrics, promoted provenance, and canonical export
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpus, synthetic evidence-agent data, localhost only, no production services, customer records, or message delivery
limitations: Local receiver path only; no production deployment or external collector
